summary: Iteration 3 end-to-end frontend testing against live Supabase (migration.sql applied, migration_phase3.sql NOT applied). Verified iteration-2 HIGH login regression fix, transaction drawer, inline custom work-category/material creation, form validation, branding, and confirmed phase-3 tables are missing. Found one HIGH frontend bug: /purchase-orders and /site-reports render endless skeleton loaders (never showing the friendly 'run migration_phase3.sql' notice) when the tables 404. Also confirmed iteration-2 LOW Recharts warning regression is NOT fully fixed — warnings still fire on dashboard load. Did not execute purchase-order or site-report functional flows because phase-3 SQL is not applied (per spec).

ui_bugs.issue: When the backing Supabase table returns 404, both /purchase-orders and /site-reports keep showing 5 skeleton loader rows indefinitely with 3+ console 404 errors and NEVER render the friendly 'this feature needs the phase-3 database update — please run supabase/migration_phase3.sql' notice that the spec (and Crud.jsx code comment) promise. This means an owner with an unmigrated project sees a broken-looking page instead of actionable guidance.

REGRESSION of iteration-2 LOW: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0 …' console warnings still fire 4–8 times on every dashboard load, even when the two charts DO render with data. Suggests ResponsiveContainer is measured before layout is committed (needs minWidth={0}/minHeight={0} or aspect prop, or defer render until parent has non-zero size).

action_items: HIGH: Fix the missing-table fallback in Crud.jsx / PurchaseOrders.jsx / SiteReports.jsx so that when Supabase returns 404 for purchase_orders / daily_site_reports the page renders the friendly 'phase-3 database update needed — please apply supabase/migration_phase3.sql' notice instead of endless skeletons + console 404s. Detect either PostgREST error code PGRST205 (relation does not exist) or HTTP 404 with a 'Not Found' body from the initial list-query.
HIGH: Guide the human user to apply /app/supabase/migration_phase3.sql to their live Supabase project (URL pddybafnmwkdzlqdhvra) so PO and DSR flows can be tested in the next iteration.

MEDIUM: In CreatableLookup save handler, catch unique-violation errors (Postgres code 23505 / PostgREST 409) and surface a toast like 'A work category / material named "X" already exists.' Currently the failure is silent.

LOW: Eliminate the Recharts 'width(-1) and height(-1)' console warnings — add minWidth={0}/minHeight={0} to the ResponsiveContainer or gate render on a measured non-zero size. Charts already render fine visually; only the warnings remain.
Nice-to-have: On dashboard, style negative cash/upi/bank card values (red pill + tooltip) so users understand why their card is negative when expenses exceed available cash.
critical_code_review_comments: Crud.jsx claims to render a 'missing-table friendly notice' (per the review request's file-of-reference summary) but empirical result shows the page just keeps skeleton loaders on Supabase 404. Check the actual error-detection branch — it likely only catches error.message.includes('does not exist') and misses PostgREST 404 responses whose body is a JSON error object rather than a JS Error with that message.
CreatableLookup save handler needs a try/catch that inspects the Supabase response error.code === '23505' and surfaces a user-facing toast — otherwise duplicate names are silently swallowed.

Dashboard Recharts container is likely wrapped in a flex/grid whose first layout pass has width 0, causing the width(-1) warnings. This is a known React 18 + Recharts 2.x issue — pass minWidth={0} on ResponsiveContainer or use a useResizeObserver gate.

rca of the issue: 1) Missing-table skeleton bug — PurchaseOrders / SiteReports (via Crud.jsx) subscribe to a supabase list query; when Supabase returns HTTP 404 for a non-existent table, the query hook likely stores the error but the loading skeleton is only gated on data===undefined, so both data and error stay 'not-loaded' → skeleton forever. Fix: treat error state as terminal-loading and render the friendly notice when error?.code==='PGRST205' or the HTTP status is 404. 2) Recharts warnings — ResponsiveContainer measures its parent before layout; first render returns width=-1/-1 until ResizeObserver fires. Adding minWidth={0}/minHeight={0} or wrapping with a conditional {mounted && <Chart/>} suppresses it. 3) Silent duplicate — CreatableLookup .insert() error is not thrown; Supabase JS returns { data:null, error } object and the component only shows toast on success.
